answer: You start with just 2 work slots. Each honest epoch adds 2 more, up to 40. Go idle 3 epochs and you drop back by 4. That's the trick: you can't buy a big quota, you earn it one epoch at a time. Cheat once and your quota resets to 2, your rewards freeze for 6 epochs, and a repeat offense doubles the climb. A thread of real work runs through every slot; you can't fake it. An orchard of 1,000 clones needs 19 honest epochs each to reach full quota, and a vine of referrals won't help, because quotas don't transfer. A full farm costs over 152,000 units in real work.
